description: This file defines the 'ConceptAttributeType' class, which extends 'BaseAttributeType' and implements 'AttributeType' for 'Concept'. It includes getter and setter methods for 'conceptAttributeTypeId' and overrides ID methods.

classes.name: ConceptAttributeType
